disclosure: Prospectively locked final analysis following exploratory protocol development on the same data.

final_estimator.treatment_contrast: hormone therapy initiation during days 0-180 versus no initiation by day 180
final_estimator.estimand: ATO difference in 730-day post-landmark restricted mean survival time, initiation minus no initiation
final_estimator.propensity_specification: cross-fitted refitted exact Stage 30 regularized specification
final_estimator.censoring_model: cross-fitted discrete-time regularized logistic censoring model
final_estimator.outcome_model: cross-fitted arm-specific ridge regression on the IPCW-RMST pseudo-outcome, bounded to [0, 730] days
final_estimator.aggregation: patient-level repeated-score aggregation across 20 nuisance partitions

publication_bootstrap.duplicate_fold_rule: all bootstrap copies of the same original patient remain in the same nuisance fold
publication_bootstrap.result_review_rule: the estimator, seeds, models, truncation, horizon, and interval definitions may not be modified after inspecting the publication-bootstrap distribution
